site.name: Greenwood International School
site.tagline: Rooted in values, reaching for the stars
site.heroTitle: Where curious minds grow into confident leaders
site.heroSubtitle: A CBSE co-educational school from Class 1 to 12 with smart classrooms, modern labs, sports and arts — and teachers who know every child by name.
site.about:
Greenwood International School was founded in 1998 by the Greenwood Education Trust with 120 students and a simple belief: every child can excel when they are known, challenged and cared for. Today more than 2,400 students learn on our 12-acre campus, guided by 140 qualified teachers.

We balance strong academics with sport, music, art, community service and life skills, so that our students leave school ready for college — and for life.
site.vision: To nurture lifelong learners who think independently, act with integrity and serve society with compassion.
mission: Deliver rigorous, joyful learning that builds deep understanding, not rote memory.
Give every child opportunities in sport, arts and leadership alongside academics.
Partner closely with parents through transparent, regular communication.
Build character: honesty, respect, responsibility and care for the environment.
site.principalQualification: M.Sc., M.Ed., Ph.D. (Education) · 26 years in education
site.principalMessage: Dear parents and students, a school is not just a building — it is a community that believes in every child. At Greenwood we want each student to discover what they love, work hard at it and grow into a kind, confident and capable person. Our doors are always open: come and see our classrooms, meet our teachers and talk to us about your child.
site.chairmanMessage: Twenty-eight years ago we set out to build a school that combines Indian values with a global outlook. I am proud of what our students, teachers and parents have built together, and we continue to invest in facilities, training and technology so that every child gets the best.
